text:
Mike Ops: FYI — partial RMA shipment arrived at FRA but customs put 8 H100 units on hold. Manifest shows 12 units total, 8 flagged. Impacting eu-west-1 provisioning pool, we're already seeing ~15% throughput reduction on dedicated runs.

Sophia Logistics: any ETA from the forwarder? AWB? :grimacing:

Ana (Vendor): Forwarder updated earlier: AWB 123-EXPD-FRA. They flagged HS code mismatch on the replacement units. We pushed corrected commercial invoice; customs response window is 24–48h. Can open an expedite request if you need air express out of FRA (extra cost).

Mike Ops: Thanks. If customs takes 48h, that's likely > SLA window for a few Dedicated tenants. Need contingency. What are expedite cost and loaner options?

Ana (Vendor): Two options: 1) expedite air (2–6 business days) at +18% freight uplift; 2) temporary loaners — we can pre-authorize 8 loaner GPUs from our pool, requires LOA and short-term credit hold. Loaners available in EU but serials will be different (needs firmware parity check).

Raj SRE: Short-term mitigation suggestions: shift batch-heavy jobs to us-east for the next 48h, enable aggressive KV-cache hit ratio lowering to reduce token churn, and reduce slot sizes for non-critical jobs. If we take loaners, require preflight test: run sysbench + nv_peer_mem smoke for 2 hours.

Mike Ops: Loaners sound promising if we can sign LOA today. What about warranty/DOA handling on loaners?

Ana (Vendor): Loaners come with 30-day limited warranty for hardware faults; DOA policy is same as replacements but we cover courier for returns. LOA terms attached. We can issue 50% credit for freight surcharge if we miss commit lead time >7 days.

rma-bot: RMA RMA-2026-087 status -> "Customs Hold" (updated 2026-04-01T09:12Z).

Sophia Logistics: Can you attach the corrected invoice here? Also need the serial list for customs clearance and our internal SKU mapping for provisioning.

Ana (Vendor): attaching corrected invoice (sent to finance@redwood.com) and serial manifest below:

```
AWB: 123-EXPD-FRA
Manifest: H100-REPL
- SN: H100-0001, H100-0002, H100-0003, H100-0004
- SN: H100-0005, H100-0006, H100-0007, H100-0008
- SN: H100-0009, H100-0010, H100-0011, H100-0012
Commercial invoice corrected: HS 8542.31.90
```

Raj SRE: Copying manifests to provisioning team. If we accept loaners, ops will need a short playbook to swap serials into staging and tag nodes as "temp-loaner" to avoid billing confusion.

Mike Ops: Agreed. Sophia, can you coordinate LOA + customs broker? If we sign LOA now and vendor ships loaners, we can restore capacity within 6–8 hours of receipt (EU dock).

Sophia Logistics: On it. I'll ping customs broker and confirm LOA template. Also routing question: if we expedite final replacements after clearance, can vendor consolidate AWBs to reduce return paperwork?

Ana (Vendor): Yes, we can consolidate replacements into a single AWB once cleared — helps with insurance and invoice reconciliation. We'll credit back handling fees on consolidation.

Mike Ops: Ok let's do LOA + loaners for immediate mitigation and proceed with corrected invoice for clearance. Raj, prepare a 2-step ops playbook (swap -> smoke -> reassign capacity) and post here when ready. :thumbsup:

Raj SRE: Will do. Drafting now, will post the short checklist and the tag commands.

Sophia Logistics: LOA signed and sent to Ana. Broker confirmed they submitted the corrected invoice at 09:40 CET. I'll update once customs acknowledges release.

Ana (Vendor): Received LOA, shipping loaners now as priority via AWB 123-LOAN-FRA. ETA to our EU staging dock ~6 hours.

Mike Ops: Great — thanks everyone. We'll track impact and open a brief postmortem if the full replacement miss hits >7 days.

Raj SRE: Posted ops checklist -> `ops/runbooks/tempo-loaner-swap.md` (internal)."
